pairs = []
used = set()
for i in range(len(unique_items)):
    if unique_items[i] in used:
        continue
    for j in range(i+1, len(unique_items)):
        if unique_items[j] in used:
            continue
        score = fuzz.token_sort_ratio(unique_items[i], unique_items[j])
        if score >= 80:
            pairs.append((unique_items[i], unique_items[j], score))
            used.add(unique_items[j])
            used.add(unique_items[i])
            break

unmatched = [u for u in unique_items if u not in used]
print("High-similarity pairs:", pairs)
print("Remaining unmatched items (treated as unique):", unmatched[:20], "...")
